summary: One church. Weekend Masses (Sat 4:00 PM, Sun 7:30 and 11:00 AM), Tuesday 9:00 AM Mass and 9:30–10:30 Adoration are printed identically in both bulletins and match history. Wednesday/Thursday Masses are 'only if previously scheduled', so the one scheduled (Thu Oct 8, 9 AM) is seeded as dated, not weekly. No confession times are printed.
